notes_for_editor: Thin record: no build date, height, owner, status, staffing or fire history in any source read. The 1954 NGS survey sheet is the only source that places a structure at the site in that year. Survey marks differ: the NGS sheet is PID RK0557, while the Michigan Fire Towers page lists PID RK0558 for the tower; they may be different marks. The coordinates agree with this record (46.08543, -87.66262). The NHLR and FFLOS Michigan index pages in the cache did not list Alfred. The 1957 map entry rests on a map-archive page's description, not on the map. The eastern Forest Lookouts page is a transcription of the NGS sheet, not a site visit. Recommend a DNR or Sturgeon River State Forest source, or a site visit, before publishing more than the basic facts. No photos added.
